summary: to_nice_json converts a variable to a nicely formatted JSON string via json.dumps; cls, default and separators are overridden internally.
questions: How do I write a nicely formatted JSON file from a variable?
Can I set separators with to_nice_json?

answer_card.title: to_nice_json filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ data | to_nice_json }}` produces a nicely formatted JSON string via `json.dumps`. The `cls`, `default` and `separators` arguments are overridden internally, so you can't set them.
